exact_correction.before: Rows-backed reset adds no store write or reset subscription: browser checkedness, current Rows data and received reversion remain separate.
exact_correction.after: Rows-backed reset never writes the store. A live row keeps its existing native reset policy; while showing a retained deleted row, Form observes the reset and restores current shown choices without replaying callbacks. Browser checkedness, captured defaults, current Rows data and received reversion remain separate.

connected_actual_reads: syncPreview retains/restores native disabled state and owns Rows-backed reset listeners only while showing a retained deleted row; returning to a live/unbound view removes those listeners.
onReset ignores disposed/paused/untrusted notifications and records only trusted native owner resets; canceled events are excluded from completed cleanup.

flushLocalResets for Rows requires the still-current deleted association and successful nativeProjection, restores only affected owners with restoreNative and runs no projection callbacks or Rows write.
restoreNative restores selected occurrences/checked member identities or native value only; native defaults and captured Form defaults remain separate.
